## Upstream: `gaussx`

Structured linear algebra and Gaussian primitives on lineax.

## Upstream: `spectraldiffx`

Pseudospectral differentiation, filters and PDE solvers.

### `spectraldiffx`

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `ChebyshevDerivative1D` | class | 1D Chebyshev derivative operator using the precomputed differentiation matrix. |
| `ChebyshevDerivative2D` | class | 2D Chebyshev derivative operators on [−Lx, Lx] × [−Ly, Ly]. |
| `ChebyshevDerivative3D` | class | 3D Chebyshev derivative operators on [−Lz, Lz] × [−Ly, Ly] × [−Lx, Lx]. |
| `ChebyshevFilter1D` | class | 1D Chebyshev spectral filter for smoothing and numerical stabilisation. |
| `ChebyshevFilter2D` | class | 2D Chebyshev spectral filter on [−Lx, Lx] × [−Ly, Ly]. |
| `ChebyshevGrid1D` | class | 1D Chebyshev grid on the domain [-L, L]. |
| `ChebyshevGrid2D` | class | 2D Chebyshev grid on [-Lx, Lx] × [-Ly, Ly]. |
| `ChebyshevGrid3D` | class | 3D Chebyshev grid on [-Lz, Lz] × [-Ly, Ly] × [-Lx, Lx]. |
| `ChebyshevHelmholtzSolver1D` | class | 1D Chebyshev-collocation Helmholtz/Poisson solver with Dirichlet or Neumann BCs. |
| `ChebyshevHelmholtzSolver2D` | class | 2D Chebyshev-collocation Helmholtz/Poisson solver with Dirichlet BCs. |
| `ChebyshevPoissonSolver1D` | class | 1D Chebyshev Poisson solver: d²u/dx² = f on [−L, L]. |
| `ChebyshevPoissonSolver2D` | class | 2D Chebyshev Poisson solver: ∇²u = f with Dirichlet BCs. |
| `ChebyshevTransform1D` | class | Forward/inverse 1D Chebyshev transform. |
| `ChebyshevTransform2D` | class | Forward/inverse 2D Chebyshev transform (tensor product of 1D). |
| `FourierGrid1D` | class | Fourier grid setup for periodic domain. |
| `FourierGrid2D` | class | 2D Fourier grid for doubly periodic domain. |
| `FourierGrid3D` | class | 3D Fourier grid for triply periodic domain. |
| `SpectralDerivative1D` | class | 1D Spectral derivative operator using the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). |
| `SpectralDerivative2D` | class | 2D Spectral derivative operators for doubly periodic rectangular domains. |
| `SpectralDerivative3D` | class | 3D Spectral derivative operators for triply periodic domains. |
| `SpectralFilter1D` | class | 1D Spectral filter for smoothing and numerical stabilization. |
| `SpectralFilter2D` | class | 2D Spectral filter for doubly periodic domains. |
| `SpectralFilter3D` | class | 3D Spectral filter for triply periodic domains. |
| `SphericalDerivative1D` | class | 1D spectral derivative operator on Gauss-Legendre latitude grid. |
| `SphericalDerivative2D` | class | 2D pseudo-spectral derivative operators on the sphere. |
| `SphericalDivergenceInversionSolver` | class | Divergence-inversion solver on the sphere. |
| `SphericalFilter1D` | class | 1D spectral filter on the Gauss–Legendre latitude grid. |
| `SphericalFilter2D` | class | 2D spectral filter on the full sphere lat-lon grid. |
| `SphericalGrid1D` | class | Gauss-Legendre grid for the latitude (colatitude) direction. |
| `SphericalGrid2D` | class | Full sphere latitude-longitude pseudo-spectral grid. |
| `SphericalHarmonicTransform` | class | Full 2D Spherical Harmonic Transform (SHT). |
| `SphericalHelmholtzDecomposition` | class | Helmholtz decomposition of a horizontal vector field on the sphere. |
| `SphericalHelmholtzSolver` | class | Spectral Helmholtz solver on the sphere:  (∇² − α) φ = f. |
| `SphericalPoissonSolver` | class | Spectral Poisson solver on the sphere:  ∇²φ = f. |
| `SphericalVorticityInversionSolver` | class | Vorticity-inversion solver on the sphere. |
| `build_capacitance_solver` | function | Pre-compute the capacitance factorisation and return a solver. |
| `cheb_dealias_product` | function | Compute the dealiased pointwise product a·b on a Chebyshev grid. |
| `chebyshev_antiderivative_coeffs` | function | Indefinite integral of a Chebyshev series, vanishing at x = −L. |
| `chebyshev_derivative_coeffs` | function | Differentiate a Chebyshev series in coefficient space (last axis). |
| `chebyshev_integral_coeffs` | function | Definite integral ∫_{−L}^{L} u(x) dx from Chebyshev coefficients. |
| `clenshaw_curtis_integrate_1d` | function | Integrate a 1D nodal field over [−L, L] using Clenshaw–Curtis. |
| `clenshaw_curtis_integrate_2d` | function | Integrate a 2D nodal field over [−Lx, Lx] × [−Ly, Ly]. |
| `clenshaw_curtis_weights` | function | Clenshaw–Curtis quadrature weights on Gauss–Lobatto nodes of [−L, L]. |
